title: Tiny, cute alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bells -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='30' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='30' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='30' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='30' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <!-- hammer -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='4' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <rect x='48' y='17' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='33' fill='#f26b6b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='28' fill='#ff9e9e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='23' fill='#fff6e5'/>
  <!-- clock hands -->
  <rect x='48' y='42' width='4' height='18' rx='2' fill='#5b4b8a'/>
  <rect x='50' y='54' width='4' height='14' rx='2' fill='#5b4b8a' transform='rotate(35 52 58)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='3' fill='#5b4b8a'/>
  <!-- tick marks -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='38' width='3' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#f26b6b'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='73' width='3' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#f26b6b'/>
  <rect x='73' y='56.5' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f26b6b'/>
  <rect x='22' y='56.5' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f26b6b'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='32' y='87' width='8' height='8' rx='4' fill='#5b4b8a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='87' width='8' height='8' rx='4' fill='#5b4b8a'/>
  <!-- little face on clock -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='54' r='2' fill='#5b4b8a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='54' r='2' fill='#5b4b8a'/>
  <path d='M45 62 Q50 67 55 62' stroke='#5b4b8a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
